proposedDraftDocuments.title: Dapur Zohor Barakah
proposedDraftDocuments.description: Dikendalikan oleh Biro Muslimat MTU sejak 28 September 2026 untuk menggalakkan solat Zohor berjemaah. Isnin–Khamis, 11.00 pagi–2.00 petang. Makan tengah hari bermula RM6: nasi putih, ayam seketul, air dan sayur. Nasi dan air boleh ditambah tanpa caj. Harga lauk tambahan mengikut harga semasa bahan mentah. Bayaran QR masjid sahaja; tunai tidak disediakan.

futureExecutionPolicy: Only after explicit approval of this exact dry-run plan.
Repeat raw revision, target-ID, slug and asset-hash checks before any upload; stop if state differs.
Upload/reuse only S01/S02/S03 unchanged source bytes. Verify returned asset ID, SHA-1, size, MIME and dimensions before binding references; any mismatch requires review.
Immediately before draft creation, repeat settings revision/payload and absence/collision checks; stop on differences.
Create the two draft documents with create semantics, in one transaction; never createIfNotExists, createOrReplace, patch the published singleton, or overwrite an existing draft.
Sanity assigns new draft revisions/timestamps. They are not source/event/publication dates and are not sent in draft payloads.
Confirm exact draft fields, only three approved new/reused assets and unchanged published records after execution. Leave drafts unpublished.
A dataset read followed by draft creation is not an atomic lock on the published singleton. Preserve the captured source revision and detect/report intervening changes before any later publication.
